title: Caesar Cipher
description: Write a Zig program that encrypts a message using the Caesar cipher with a shift of 3.
verificationTest: output.includes('Original: Hello, Zig!') && output.includes('Encrypted: Khoor, Zlj!')
hints: Zig uses `and` instead of `&&` for logical AND
Use character arithmetic: `ch - 'a'` gives 0-based alphabet index
Only shift letters, leave other characters unchanged
Use `{c}` format specifier for printing characters
